notes:
Snapshot from AE/SE cadence and discovery calls. Short, choppy CRM style.
- Company: Silverpine builds a product-analytics assistant embedded in their SaaS product — agents + in-app help + search. Mid-market, ~400 employees, revenue-growing.
- Initial ask: low-latency chat for in-app assistant + vector search for docs and reranking of analytics results. Also want embeddings for similarity and summarization jobs.
- Evaluation plan: start on Redwood Hosted API for speed of integration, then pilot Redwood Dedicated for predictable throughput and lower unit cost. POC window proposed: 4 weeks Dedicated burst to compare economics vs hosted (team wants numbers).
- Key quotes: Head of Product: "We need median latency under 200ms for typical chat flows — p99 can be higher but must be predictable." CFO: "Show TCO delta vs OpenAI — if Dedicated reduces cost per 1M tokens by 40% we can commit." Engineering lead: "Need KV/prefix caching and persistent cache for repeated queries."
- Security: SSO (SAML) mandatory; SOC2 required for procurement; EU data residency for subset of EU customers (routing + region pinning discussion). KMS integration required for customer-managed keys.
- Cost optimization focus raised during discovery: batching strategies (dynamic batching for peaks), prefix/KV cache for repeated sessions, quantization profiles for Mistral/gpt-like open models, and expected unit economics using Redwood Optimize recommendations.
- Acceptance criteria for POC: validate 3 workloads (chat 50–150 QPS, embeddings batch jobs nightly, reranking 200 queries/sec burst), demonstrate cost per active MAU within forecast, show no regression on F1 for reranking eval set (baseline: current internal model), and SSO + audit_log proof of concept completed.
- Documentation links: pricing deck (drive:/deals/silverpine/2026-03-pricing-deck.pdf), security FAQ response (drive:/security/silverpine/security-faq-response.docx).
- Internal notes: prioritize Optimize workshop early (helps procurement). AE/SE to run a unit-economics session with Product + Finance. Ask: sample 7-day token histogram from their staging logs to model batching/caching impact.
- Typical CRM shorthand: "POC needs: hosted -> dedicated, cost-workshop, quantization trial, routing policies (EU), SSO + KMS, finalize commit if 40%+ cost savings seen."
